about: Sixfold's custom instructions (opcode custom-0). Edit this file or design them in web/custom.html, then run `make custom` to regenerate src/Custom_Unit.sv and the model, and `make test` to check the RTL against the model. Language: model/custom.js. Guide: docs/CUSTOM_INSTRUCTIONS.md.

instructions.name: absdiff
instructions.expr: a > b ? a - b : b - a
instructions.desc: Absolute difference (unsigned): the core of motion search in video encoders (sum of absolute differences)

instructions.name: avgu
instructions.desc: Average of two unsigned numbers, rounded down, that cannot overflow (the shared bits plus half the different ones)

instructions.name: hamming
instructions.desc: Hamming distance: how many bits differ (error-correcting codes, comparing fingerprints)

instructions.name: clampi
instructions.desc: Clamp a signed number to 0 ... imm (saturate a pixel to 0 ... 255 in one instruction)

instructions.name: hsec.cteq
instructions.desc: Constant-time equality: 1 if rs1 equals rs2, in the same time whatever the operands (no early exit to leak how much matched). From HYDRA-130's Xhydrasec extension; see docs/learn/12_adding_instructions.md

instructions.name: paddus.b
instructions.desc: Packed: 8 bytes added, each saturating at 255 instead of wrapping (brightening pixels, additive blending of light and particles, mixing 8-bit audio)

instructions.name: psubus.b
instructions.desc: Packed: 8 bytes subtracted, each stopping at 0 instead of wrapping (darkening, shadow masks, image differences)

instructions.name: pavgu.b
instructions.desc: Packed: the rounded average of 8 pairs of bytes (50% blends, halving an image for a mipmap, motion compensation in video)

instructions.name: pmaxu.b
instructions.desc: Packed: the larger of each of 8 pairs of bytes (image dilation, keeping the brightest sample, per-channel clamps)

instructions.name: pminu.b
instructions.desc: Packed: the smaller of each of 8 pairs of bytes (image erosion, per-channel clamps)

instructions.name: psad.b
instructions.desc: Packed: the sum of the 8 bytes' absolute differences, one number (motion search in video encoders, template matching, comparing image blocks)

instructions.name: pdot.b
instructions.desc: Packed: dot product of 8 signed bytes, a 64-bit sum (int8 neural-network layers, 8-tap filters, convolution kernels)

instructions.name: pdot.h
instructions.desc: Packed: dot product of 4 signed 16-bit numbers, a 64-bit sum (fixed-point vectors and matrices for 3D, audio filters)

instructions.name: pmulhrs.h
instructions.desc: Packed: 4 Q15 fixed-point multiplies, rounded, -1 x -1 saturating to the largest value (audio gain and mixing, fixed-point lighting)
